name: NSE Catalyst Python 3.12
updateContentCommand: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y $(grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' packages.txt); fi && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; fi && python -m compileall -q . && echo 'Environment, dependencies, and Python syntax verified'
